title: carlina corymbosa subsp. graeca
intro: Carlina corymbosa subsp. graeca, commonly known as the Greek carline thistle, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and digestive problems. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Carlina corymbosa subsp. graeca include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects.
